answer:
The NASA profile page shows the account name as **NASA** (@nasa) and its follower count as **104M followers**.

I read this from the page text. A login dialog was covering the profile, and I left it as it was. The tab is still open on https://www.instagram.com/nasa/.

The page's meta description also says "104M Followers", so the two agree.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); agent-browser --session $S open https://www.instagram.com/nasa/ && agent-browser --session $S snapshot | head -60
